comparison.objective: Commission a damper, versus separate corrugated packaging and transfer supply boxes across a clean-line partition.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires precision tool use and response-guided tuning; record requires insert removal, bimanual handoffs through a constrained pass-through, and shelf placement.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two safe bounded impact cycles. Record awards correct insert disposal and box placement while zeroing cardboard contamination past the partition.
comparison.reason: Clean-line material transfer and handoff are materially different from mechanical adjustment and dynamic commissioning. The record gives no placement tolerances, but its unrelated objective remains clear.
